name: mirror-tray-unplugged
description: Remove the workstation's phone-mirror tray icon when the phone comes off its charger at home. The counterpart of mirror-tray-plugged, with the same ip condition and the same idempotent forced-command verb, so a retry is harmless. An open mirror window stays up: the workstation only stops the icon.

actions.message: asked ${params.host} to remove the mirror tray icon

params.label: Workstation verb that removes the icon
